item.text: The priority filter is shared across project views, so opening a project after using another one can inherit that prior selection. I’ll reset both task filters to their required initial values when `Open project` is used; direct URL reloads already start with the HTML defaults.

item.text:
Updated project-list navigation to reset both task filters to `All`, including when opening an archived project. This addresses the acceptance failure where `Priority filter` retained `Normal`.

Committed as `9946ce5fd2187f9bbe71bb9f4f2a26915bc777e8`. The working tree is clean.

Run with `npm start` (default port 8080; configure with `PORT` and `DB_PATH`).
